params.body:
Replaces #157 (opened by mistake with a probe title and only the stylesheet; please close it).

- Mobile menu: the theme hid the drawer only after its JS added mini-sidebar, so every page load flashed the open menu. Hidden by CSS until show-sidebar.
- Detail header on phones: title on its own line with side padding, customer-mode toggle under it, actions under that.
- Actions toggle: when open it becomes the head of a panel and the actions sit inside it; label Acties verbergen.
- Real Garant and Flexlease blocks: the skewed banner with stripes is gone; one quiet pattern (title with icon, partner logo on a dark tile, text, fields grid, result sentence with the amount in bold). Bootstrap row/col markup replaced; JS selectors kept (data-warranty instead of .row).
- Flexlease: an empty or sealed answer no longer prints vanaf EUR NaN but Leaseprijs is nu niet beschikbaar; the spinner also stops on a failed request.
- The skew CSS stays: the offer/order screens and the website theme still use it.
params.title: Vehicle detail on phones: header, actions panel, partner blocks, drawer flash
